subScenes.name: 初次问候
subScenes.description: 顾客到店打招呼，顾问热情接待并询问需求。

qaPairs.triggerText: Welcome to FitLife Gym! Are you new here?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 欢迎来到FitLife健身房！您是第一次来吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 健身房初次问候：前台询问是否为新会员

followUps.text: Yes, I am. I’d like to sign up for a membership.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，我是新来的。我想办一张会员卡。

followUps.text: Actually, I’m just checking it out first. Can I tour the facility?
followUps.text_cn: 其实我只是先来看看。我可以参观一下设施吗？

followUps.text: No, I’m a member already, but I forgot my card.
followUps.text_cn: 不是，我已经是会员了，但忘带卡了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 这是健身房接待新访客的标准开场白，用户可能有办卡、参观或身份确认三种不同需求。

qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您今天来健身房是有什么目标呢？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 健身房初次问候：教练或前台询问来访目的

followUps.text: I want to lose weight and get in shape.
followUps.text_cn: 我想减脂塑形。

followUps.text: I’m training for a marathon next month.
followUps.text_cn: 我下个月要参加马拉松，需要训练。

followUps.text: I just need somewhere to unwind after work.
followUps.text_cn: 我只是想找地方下班后放松一下。

qaPairs.usageNote: 此问题用于了解用户健身动机，回应应简洁明确，避免冗长解释。

qaPairs.triggerText: Would you like a free trial session today?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您今天想体验一次免费课程吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 健身房初次问候：主动提供免费体验机会

followUps.text: Yes, please! What’s available right now?
followUps.text_cn: 好的，请问现在有什么课程可以体验？

followUps.text: Maybe later—I need to check my schedule first.
followUps.text_cn: 也许改天吧，我得先看看我的时间安排。

followUps.text: No thanks, I already have a plan.
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，谢谢，我已经有计划了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 这是健身房常见的转化话术，用户回应需体现真实决策状态，避免机械回答。

subScenes.name: 询问设施
subScenes.description: 顾客了解健身房设备、泳池、更衣室等配套服务。

qaPairs.triggerText: What facilities do you have available?

followUps.text: We have a full cardio zone, free weights, functional training area, and a 25-meter indoor pool.
followUps.text_cn: 我们有全套有氧区、自由重量区、功能性训练区和一个25米室内泳池。

followUps.text: We offer strength equipment, group classes, and a sauna, but no pool or climbing wall.
followUps.text_cn: 我们提供力量器械、团体课程和桑拿房，但没有泳池或攀岩墙。

followUps.text: Our main facilities are weights and cardio machines; we also have a small stretching area and locker rooms with showers.
followUps.text_cn: 我们的主要设施是力量器械和有氧设备，还有小块拉伸区和带淋浴的更衣室。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于初次咨询时了解健身房整体配置，适合新手或比较不同健身房的用户

qaPairs.triggerText: Are you interested in a personal training session?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您有兴趣尝试私人教练课程吗？

followUps.text: Yes, I’d like to start with two sessions a week to build a routine.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，我想每周安排两次，先建立训练习惯。

followUps.text: No thanks, I’m comfortable working out on my own for now.
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，谢谢，我现在习惯自己练。

followUps.text: I’m not sure—can you tell me how much it costs?
followUps.text_cn: 我不确定——能告诉我价格吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 服务员常在介绍完设施后自然引导至私教销售，用户回应需体现真实态度差异

qaPairs.triggerText: Can I use the swimming pool with my membership?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我的会员资格包含泳池使用吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 确认特定设施是否包含在会员权益中

followUps.text: Yes, the pool is included in all standard memberships—open daily from 6 AM to 9 PM.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，泳池包含在所有标准会员中，每天早上6点到晚上9点开放。

followUps.text: Sorry, the pool is only available with our premium plan. Would you like to upgrade?
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，泳池仅限高级会员使用。您要升级吗？

followUps.text: The pool is closed for maintenance this week, but it’ll reopen next Monday.
followUps.text_cn: 泳池本周因维修关闭，下周一重新开放。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用户常针对具体设施（如泳池、桑拿）确认权益，回应需覆盖可用、不可用、临时关闭三种真实情况

subScenes.name: 了解时间
subScenes.description: 顾客咨询营业时间、高峰时段及预约规则。

qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你们的高峰时段是什么时候？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 用户询问健身房高峰时段以避开拥挤

followUps.text: Our peak hours are 6–8 AM and 5–7 PM on weekdays.
followUps.text_cn: 我们的高峰时段是工作日早上6点到8点，以及下午5点到7点。

followUps.text: Weekends are busy all day, but midday on weekdays is usually quiet.
followUps.text_cn: 周末全天都忙，但工作日中午时段通常比较安静。

followUps.text: I’d recommend coming around 10 AM — it’s calm and equipment is free.
followUps.text_cn: 我建议你上午10点来，那时候人少，器械也空着。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用户询问高峰时段以规划锻炼时间，服务员应提供具体时段并可附加优化建议

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have early morning sessions?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 用户想确认是否有晨间团体课程

followUps.text: Yes, we have yoga and HIIT classes starting at 6:30 AM.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，我们早上6:30有瑜伽和高强度间歇训练课程。

followUps.text: We don’t offer morning classes, but you can use the cardio area anytime from 5 AM.
followUps.text_cn: 我们没有早课，但您从早上5点起就可以使用有氧器械区。

followUps.text: Morning classes are on hold until next month due to staff shortages.
followUps.text_cn: 由于人手不足，早课暂时停办，下个月恢复。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用户关心晨间课程，服务员需如实告知是否提供、替代方案或临时变动

qaPairs.triggerText: What time do you close on weekends?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 用户想确认周末营业结束时间以便安排锻炼

followUps.text: We close at 10 PM on weekends.
followUps.text_cn: 周末我们晚上10点关门。

followUps.text: We’re open until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays for late-night members.
followUps.text_cn: 周五和周六我们营业到午夜，为夜间会员提供服务。

followUps.text: We close at 8 PM on Sundays — it’s our deep cleaning day.
followUps.text_cn: 周日我们8点关门，那是我们的深度清洁日。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用户询问关门时间，服务员需区分周末类型并说明是否有特殊安排或原因

subScenes.name: 对比方案
subScenes.description: 顾问介绍不同会员套餐，顾客比较价格与权益。

qaPairs.triggerText: Are you looking for a basic membership or something more comprehensive?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您是想选基础会员，还是更全面的套餐？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 健身房顾问向顾客介绍不同会员方案，引导对比选择

followUps.text: I want the basic one — I just need access to weights and cardio.
followUps.text_cn: 我要基础套餐，只需要器械和有氧区。

followUps.text: I’m torn — the premium package has classes I like, but it’s way over my budget.
followUps.text_cn: 我犹豫了，高级套餐有我喜欢的课程，但超预算了。

followUps.text: Can I try the premium for a week and downgrade later if it’s too much?
followUps.text_cn: 我能先试一周高级套餐，如果太贵再降级吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于顾客在选择会员等级时，表达不同需求、预算和灵活性的典型回应

qaPairs.triggerText: Would you prefer a 12-month contract or a month-to-month plan?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您更倾向12个月合约，还是按月付费？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 健身房顾问询问合同期限，引导顾客权衡长期优惠与短期灵活

followUps.text: I’ll go with the 12-month — the discount makes sense for me.
followUps.text_cn: 我选12个月的，折扣划算。

followUps.text: I’m not sure I’ll stick with it — I need month-to-month just in case.
followUps.text_cn: 我不确定能不能坚持，还是按月付更保险。

followUps.text: Do you offer a 6-month option? I’d prefer something in between.
followUps.text_cn: 你们有6个月的选项吗？我想要个中间方案。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于顾客在合同期限选择时，表达经济考量、不确定性或个性化需求

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you want to add personal training sessions to your plan?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您要加私人教练课程吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾问推荐附加服务，顾客需决定是否购买额外服务

followUps.text: Yes, I’d like two sessions a week — I need help with form.
followUps.text_cn: 要，我想每周两次，需要纠正动作。

followUps.text: Not right now — I’ll start with the gym alone and see how it goes.
followUps.text_cn: 现在不要，我想先自己练着看情况。

followUps.text: Are the trainers certified? I don’t want to waste money on someone unqualified.
followUps.text_cn: 教练有资质吗？我不想为不合格的人花钱。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于顾客面对附加服务推荐时，表达意愿、谨慎态度或信息核查需求

subScenes.name: 参观体验
subScenes.description: 顾问带领顾客参观场地，现场体验器械与氛围。

qaPairs.triggerText: Would you like a guided tour of the facility?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您需要导览整个健身房吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 健身房顾问主动提供导览服务

followUps.text: Yes, please! I'm new here and want to know where everything is.
followUps.text_cn: 好的，请带我看看！我是新手，想了解所有设备的位置。

followUps.text: No thanks, I'm familiar with gyms—I'll explore on my own.
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，我熟悉健身房，我自己逛就行。

followUps.text: Can we do it after I change? I need to freshen up first.
followUps.text_cn: 我能换完衣服后再导览吗？我先整理一下。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于顾客刚到店时，工作人员主动提供导览服务的典型开场互动

qaPairs.triggerText: What kind of equipment are you interested in?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客主动询问器械推荐，寻求个性化建议

followUps.text: We have a full cardio zone with treadmills, ellipticals, and rowing machines—plus free weights and functional training areas.
followUps.text_cn: 我们有完整的有氧区，包括跑步机、椭圆机和划船机，还有自由重量区和功能性训练区。

followUps.text: If you're focusing on recovery, we have a dedicated stretching and foam roller zone, plus massage guns available.
followUps.text_cn: 如果您注重恢复，我们有专门的拉伸和泡沫轴区域，还提供按摩枪。

followUps.text: We also offer free group classes like HIIT and yoga—would you like to try one today?
followUps.text_cn: 我们还提供免费团体课程，比如HIIT和瑜伽，今天要参加一节吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客询问器械偏好时，工作人员根据不同需求提供精准推荐的典型回应

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you want to sign up for a membership today?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 体验结束，顾问促成签约的关键时刻

followUps.text: Yes, I'll go with the basic monthly plan.
followUps.text_cn: 好的，我就选基础月卡。

followUps.text: Can I think about it? I want to compare a few gyms first.
followUps.text_cn: 我能再考虑一下吗？我想先比较几家健身房。

followUps.text: Do you offer a trial week? I'd like to come back and train a few times before deciding.
followUps.text_cn: 你们有试用周吗？我想回来练几次再决定。

qaPairs.usageNote: 体验结束时，顾问促成转化的高频提问，用户回应体现不同决策态度
